newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU declines comment on BUBA gold plan reaction.
newsitem.headline: EU declines comment on BUBA gold plan reaction.

text.p: The European Commission has no comment on the rejection on Thursday by the Bundesbank of German government plans to revalue its gold assets, monetary spokesman Patrick Child said.

Child, spokesman for Economic Affairs Commissioner Yves- Thibault de Silguy, said the Commission would follow its standard policy of declining to comment on the German plan in the absence of a formal proposal.
"As yet, there is no formal decision or proposal from German authorities," he told Reuters. "Therefore, it is premature for a reaction from the Commission."
German Finance Minister Theo Waigel two weeks ago announced plans to revalue the central bank's assets to give a much-needed injection of cash to Bonn's strapped public finances.

In its statement, the Bundesbank said the Bonn concept was not in line with rules planned for changes to central bank accounting after the move to a single currency as it linked the revaluation to an immediate payout of the unrealised profit.
